patch:
diff --git a/sql/sql_acl.cc b/sql/sql_acl.cc
index 01927d1899536..e61940ea82d13 100644
--- a/sql/sql_acl.cc
+++ b/sql/sql_acl.cc
@@ -7580,10 +7580,18 @@ bool check_grant(THD *thd, ulong want_access, TABLE_LIST *tables,
     sctx= t_ref->security_ctx ? t_ref->security_ctx : thd->security_ctx;
     ulong orig_want_access= original_want_access;
 
-    if (t_ref->sequence)
+    /*
+      If sequence is used as part of NEXT VALUE, PREVIUS VALUE or SELECT,
+      we need to modify the requested access rights depending on how the
+      sequence is used.
+    */
+    if (t_ref->sequence &
+        (orig_want_access &
+         (SELECT_ACL | INSERT_ACL | UPDATE_ACL | DELETE_ACL)))
     {
-      /* We want to have either SELECT or INSERT rights to sequences depending
-         on how they are accessed
+      /*
+        We want to have either SELECT or INSERT rights to sequences depending
+        on how they are accessed
       */
       orig_want_access= ((t_ref->lock_type == TL_WRITE_ALLOW_WRITE) ?
                          INSERT_ACL : SELECT_ACL);
diff --git a/sql/sql_sequence.cc b/sql/sql_sequence.cc
index f19dd540c4ef5..53c9c16059337 100644
--- a/sql/sql_sequence.cc
+++ b/sql/sql_sequence.cc
@@ -849,7 +849,7 @@ bool Sql_cmd_alter_sequence::execute(THD *thd)
                    0, 0))
     DBUG_RETURN(TRUE);                  /* purecov: inspected */
 
-  if (check_grant(thd, ALTER_ACL, first_table, FALSE, UINT_MAX, FALSE))
+  if (check_grant(thd, ALTER_ACL, first_table, FALSE, 1, FALSE))
     DBUG_RETURN(TRUE);                  /* purecov: inspected */
 
   if (lex->check_exists)
